answer: Cluster identities by money flow: the ledger traces who funded each new account, and accounts sharing a funding ancestor are merged into one cluster whose payout is split like a single agent. Honest strangers fund themselves separately, so they keep full rewards. A sybil farmer must fund every fake from an independent source, which costs real capital per head, and a quill-thin trail of tiny transfers still leaves a beacon that audits follow back to the zenith wallet.
